# cloudsmith_saml_auth (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

resource "cloudsmith_saml_auth" "example" {
  organization       = "my-organization"
  saml_auth_enabled  = true
  saml_auth_enforced = false

  # Use either saml_metadata_url OR saml_metadata_inline
  saml_metadata_url = "https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml"

  # Alternative: Use inline metadata
  # saml_metadata_inline = <<EOF
  # <?xml version="1.0"?>
  # <EntityDescriptor xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata">
  #   <IDPSSODescriptor>
  #     <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect"
  #                         Location="https://idp.example.com/sso"/>
  #   </IDPSSODescriptor>
  # </EntityDescriptor>
  # EOF
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug for SAML authentication
- `saml_auth_enabled` (Boolean) Enable SAML authentication for the organization
- `saml_auth_enforced` (Boolean) Enforce SAML authentication for the organization

### Optional

- `saml_metadata_inline` (String) Inline SAML metadata XML
- `saml_metadata_url` (String) URL to fetch SAML metadata

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
